findings.issue: The technical_record changes the source's 'an instrument stops earlier than heating' into 'an instrument stops before heating'. The new wording can mean instrument failure before heating begins, rather than the distinct observation-stop and heating-stop endpoints specified by the source. This changes the synthetic example's chronology and obscures the continued-heating/unknown-later-observation case.
findings.exact_correction: In technical_record replace 'an instrument stops before heating' with 'an instrument’s observation ends before heating ends'. Retain the existing separate observation-stop, heating-stop, valid-sensor-interval and unknown-later-behavior acceptance conditions.
findings.resolution: Applied in assembled record; targeted read-only reviewer recheck confirmed resolution before publication.
